messages:
maria-partners: Heads-up — Stonebridge onboarding is blocked by the marketplace PO ack mismatch + a hard export-control redline from their legal. Partner says they can't sign our indemnity change. Can we decide a short-term workaround to let them provision reserved capacity? cc @josh-deals @ana-legal :eyes:

josh-deals: ugh. what do you mean by ack mismatch? is PO number wrong or portal failing to accept?

maria-partners: portal accepted their PO but our ledger shows different buyer entity. Their portal ack uses partner-vendor-id 9987, our PO shows vendor-id 9991. When partner tried to update entity, portal validation rejected it. PO#: SB-2026-042.

portal-bot: Automated notice: marketplace-ack-retry 3/3 failed for PO SB-2026-042, error code EDI_ACCEPT_MISMATCH. Ticket created: MP-7654.

ana-legal: tagging in. I reviewed the redline — Stonebridge removed our reciprocal indemnity clause citing EU export exposure. They added export carveouts that our legal can't accept as-is. I pushed suggested compromise language to the shared drive (link: https://redwood/drive/stonebridge-eu-export-draft). Need product/ops signoff to keep timeline.

patrick-sales: Partner is pushing for go-live next week — their SI integration depends on early access. Sales can escalate to their CPO if legal confirms path forward. Is there a mitigation that avoids changing contract? Maybe a short-term MSA addendum limited to this deployment? :handshake:

sheila-billing: Also a billing question — if we provision now and partner later submits corrected PO, can we invoice against a provisional invoice? Our finance requires matching vendor id for PO-based invoicing. Without matching, we may need to invoice direct and do a credit adjust later. That delays revenue recognition.

josh-deals: Options I see: 1) manual override in portal to accept vendor 9987 for this PO and attach an internal note + ticket; 2) ask partner to reissue PO with vendor 9991 (slower); 3) provision under a temporary seat with attached commercial hold until contract/PO reconciled. Which of these are we comfortable with?

ana-legal: I prefer option 3 if we can limit exposure. Proposed conditions: (a) provisioning only for dev/staging until legal signoff; (b) limited liability carveout documented in an internal SOW; (c) no production traffic until MSA amendment executed. If sales signs off on risk, legal will fast-track amendment.

maria-partners: I'm fine with 3 on the condition operations can unlock a non-prod pool quickly. Ops: can we spin a sandbox dedicated pool tied to SB-2026-042 in <24h? @devops oncall?

portal-bot: NOTE: Manual ack override requires admin service ticket. Raise ticket with tag portal-admin and include MP-7654.

josh-deals: I can talk to partner now to request reissued PO as backup, but we should proceed with temporary provisioning if ops confirms. I'll also ask for written confirmation that they accept production hold.

sheila-billing: From finance perspective: if we do temp provisioning, create a 'deferred invoice' flag in charge metadata. I can process invoice as provisional and mark for reconciliation once vendor id fixed. Need approvals from revenue ops though.

patrick-sales: I'll ping their CPO and get a written note agreeing to the hold. If needed, I'll offer a small onboarding credit to keep them happy.

ana-legal: I'll prepare a one-page addendum template and drop it in the drive. If sales agrees, I'll route for exec counter-signature. timeline: I can have draft in 3 hours.

maria-partners: Next steps agreed: josh to request reissued PO and written acceptance of hold; ops to confirm sandbox provisioning timeline; legal to prepare addendum; finance to flag deferred invoice flow. I'll open an internal task and tag MP-7654.

josh-deals: on it. pinging Stonebridge now.

sheila-billing: looping in rev-ops: @rev-ops please confirm we can accept deferred invoice metadata and reconcile after PO fix.

portal-bot: Ticket MP-7654 updated: workflow=escalated_to_admin; assignees=[portal-admin, rev-ops].

maria-partners: thanks all. tagging this for follow-up in #partnerships tomorrow EOD. :memo:
